## One connected route, with room to investigate

1. Implement the canon's brief in-engine opening and transition to control. Interacting with restraint, service latch and purge should make immediate damage understandable. A skip/replay-safe path must reach the same valid pod state without duplicating rewards or consuming survival while control is unavailable. Preserve the canon's trajectory and ambiguity. Show captions and pause behavior; a text-only lore modal is not the entire opening.
2. Give the home pod a coherent usable interior/threshold with dependable air, gradual healing, identifiable storage and fabrication. Starting damage supplies a repair objective without withholding the only safe refuge or basic recovery. Warm sound/light and practical equipment should make returning comforting. Player mode, physical location and refuge authority must agree.
3. Build a learnable Hearth Reef–Splitspine workshop loop with C01–C03 and appropriate scan records. The intake, current-facing colonies, downstream ribbon catches, exposed glass ledges and maintenance scraps explain the resources and records. Use at least two suitable patches for critical first materials. Keep food accessible without craftable tools or a starvation prerequisite. Restore the workshop as an actual fabrication/refuge service, not just a blueprint popup.
4. Let reef-first and island-first investigation work. Store findings with provenance and distinguish observation from hypothesis. Regional leads and voluntary graduated hints point to landmarks/conditions; do not pin undiscovered clue coordinates. A notebook retains facts and practical preparation information. Discovery order changes interpretation without deleting knowledge. Optional personal records cannot lock required crafting or facilities.
5. Include a bounded upper-Canopy approach for the first powered outing, C04 and a meaningful observation/retreat decision. Keep its required route within the preceding equipment's personal and hull limits. It must introduce actual ecology and a useful next lead, not a final-screen promise standing in for play. M2 expands the remaining regions; avoid filling unimplemented routes with misleading interactions.

## Gather, build, travel and return

Adopt the **implemented M1 subset** of the accepted economy into the single typed runtime registry. The proposal JSON is reference, never a second loaded authority. Preserve stable region/material/hull IDs. Link source patches, stock, recipe prerequisites, blueprint knowledge, fabrication site, output CU, asset and depletion by IDs. Seed only actual available interactions; do not display later craft/recipes as working when absent.

Use candidate costs/yields as the starting budget, not proven balance. Include pod/workshop repairs, essential tools, basic 150 m suit, reusable salvage buoy, reserve power, meals and first hull in the actual guaranteed-stock calculation. Each transfer/craft checks capacity, location, knowledge, inputs and output clearance before mutation; a refusal consumes nothing. Distinct portable/fitted equipment and containers have identities. A deployed buoy's cargo cannot simultaneously count in a packed item or diver hold. Persistent learned blueprints must survive hull loss and allow rebuilding; do not replace knowledge with current reachability flags.

Implement the **Dart** as the first tested craft: distinct visible access, deliberate board/exit, acceleration/steering, power, hull damage/depth warning, real cargo transfer and supported charging/repair. Its 180 m rating is distinct from the diver's 60/150 m protection. Exit clearance and exposure must be legible before disembarking. Demonstrate one route where the scout changes range or approach. Do not encode Dart ownership as a prerequisite for the future independent Creel starter route. Keep the six-hull roster and both complete campaign strategies intact.

Tune this route with actual normal controls: useful first collection payload, credible return path and at least 25% oxygen/power reserve on the intended conservative approach. Show measured stock/route consumption, not just a reachability boolean. Reduce empty travel, repeated ferrying or excessive quantities when evidence shows chores. Never pad M1 or ten hours through waiting; material changes to candidate quantities require an explicit before/after rationale and checker reconciliation.

## Survival, ecology and recovery

Activate oxygen, personal pressure, vehicle power/damage and food with clear UI/audio warnings and visual equivalents. Define and record stable simulation-space reference points for personal pressure, physical airway/water contact and hull depth; never derive survival from the renderer's interpolated eye height. No thirst, meal decay or predator-trophy progression. Food lasts a useful expedition; starvation first gives warnings/grace while ordinary swimming/gathering remain viable. Refuges and recovery supplies prevent an empty-inventory loop. Pause, blocking cutscenes and interruptions freeze relevant simulation drains.

Make at least one observable ecological relation useful: filter flow/shed catches or grazers/exposed glass, plus a territorial sound hunter on the outing. Threat states should warn, investigate, pursue and disengage with visible/audio cues; quiet movement, cover or a defensive distraction must work. Keep the pod and sole recovery exit safe. Scan prose must describe implemented behavior, not simulated ecology that does not exist.

A gameplay-triggered incapacity returns to a valid refuge with retained knowledge/essential tools and enough food to restart. Drop a limited identified ordinary cargo cache; keep the disabled Dart with cargo/module/charge identity and a visited-site recovery marker. Implement a local repair/tow or salvage loop using reachable shallow stock and a reusable rescue tool/collar as appropriate to the M1 route. No global summon, invisible free duplicate hull, or a second upgraded vessel prerequisite. A failed recovery must remain recoverable; prove repeated failure conservation. Bound protected maintenance provenance so repair/salvage/dismantling cannot launder it into optional purchases. Numeric ECO cycles do not establish this physical route. Full deep Bobbin topology remains M2 work.

## Carrier and collision feasibility before expansion

Introduce the workshop's incomplete large construction berth as a recognizable future opportunity, with no false claim that the campaign carrier is already available. Separately exercise a **simplified physical carrier fixture using production state/controller/collision/persistence seams** before multiplying vehicle art. Keep any seeded fixture distinct from normal New Game and label its evidence as feasibility, not earned campaign progression.

Prove station keeping before helm exit/launch; a walkable stationary interior; two compact craft including a dry surface-only Spindle proxy; safe launch of the other craft without flooding Spindle; one-medium configuration only after empty supported-dock reconfiguration; blocked exits preserving identity/cargo/charge/damage; exactly-once detachment; save/reload and interruption at capture/launch boundaries; safe refuge fallback on death inside. Spindle launches only at the surface. Do not implement or imply walking underway without its separate gate. Local berth transforms and world transforms must remain explicit and coherent.

Use shared world geometry for terrain/colliders, swept movement for diver/scout/representative large hull and clear clearance previews. Include waterline/shore/ramp transitions, narrow-route collisions and a blocked launch. If feasibility fails, fix or simplify the mechanism while retaining the required roles; do not defer a failed gate under detailed artwork.
